name: breadcrumb-04
title: Breadcrumb with icons
description: Each parent page carries an icon before its name.

files.content:
'use client';

import { ComponentIcon, HomeIcon } from '@/registry/ndeko/lib/icons';
import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from '@/registry/ndeko/ui/breadcrumb';

export default function Breadcrumb04() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href='#' className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5'>
            <HomeIcon className='size-4' />
            Home
          </BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href='#' className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5'>
            <ComponentIcon className='size-4' />
            Components
          </BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Breadcrumb</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}
